categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the design, manufacturing, and sales of non-standard automated intelligent assembly and testing equipment, focusing on lithium-ion battery manufacturing equipment and consumer electronics intelligent manufacturing devices. It also engages in the research, production, and sales of consumer battery packs through its subsidiary. The main product lines include lithium battery manufacturing equipment such as coating machines, injection machines, helium leak detectors, and packaging equipment, as well as consumer electronics assembly lines and battery pack applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies in lithium-ion battery manufacturing equipment, including advanced coating, injection, helium leak detection, laser measurement, and packaging technologies. It employs modular design, virtual simulation, and digital manufacturing processes to enhance product quality and efficiency. The company also integrates AI and digital systems for full lifecycle project management and has developed specialized equipment for emerging battery types like solid-state and sodium-ion batteries.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers such as CATL, BYD, Sunwoda, and Ford, as well as consumer electronics companies like Midea and Philips. The company serves industries including new energy vehicles, consumer electronics, semiconductor, photovoltaic, medical, and smart home sectors. Its products are critical in battery production lines and intelligent manufacturing processes across these markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing bases in Shenzhen and Zhongshan. It has expanded its international presence with offices and subsidiaries in Italy, Hungary, Vietnam, and other countries, targeting overseas markets including Europe, Southeast Asia, and India. Overseas orders and local service centers support its global expansion strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, providing manufacturing equipment and assembly solutions for battery cell production and pack assembly. Through acquisition of a battery pack manufacturer, it has extended its presence downstream into battery pack production and consumer battery applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing core product competitiveness, advancing R&D in next-generation battery manufacturing equipment for emerging battery technologies (solid-state, sodium-ion), and expanding global market reach. The company emphasizes digital transformation, modular design, and AI integration in manufacturing. It also focuses on multi-industry diversification, including semiconductor testing, photovoltaic, medical, and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized non-standard automated manufacturing equipment, related parts, and value-added services such as equipment upgrades and maintenance. The company also earns revenue from sales of consumer battery packs via its subsidiary. Sales are conducted mainly through direct contracts with customers, including bidding and negotiation processes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a national high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise with a leading market position in lithium battery coating equipment, recognized as a provincial manufacturing champion. Competitors include other domestic lithium battery equipment manufacturers like Lead Intelligent, Yinghe Technology, and Liyuanheng. The company maintains a competitive edge through proprietary technology, product quality, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 506 million, a 54.7% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 128 million. The decline was due to reduced equipment deliveries amid industry demand slowdown. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.16 billion, with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity expansion. Despite short-term setbacks, order backlog exceeded RMB 1.3 billion by April 2025, indicating recovery potential.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and technologically advanced intelligent manufacturing equipment tailored to customer-specific processes. Its products feature modular design, digital integration, and AI-enabled quality control, enabling enhanced production efficiency and cost reduction. The company’s deep industry expertise, extensive patent portfolio, and close collaboration with leading battery manufacturers differentiate it in the competitive landscape.
